scope: CSV readers preserve exact model requests and validate opaque supplied pins

baseline.reference: Immutable private worktree based public313d6165cfb; both target reader ASTs proven identical to implementation base before edits.

owning.warning: Existing runpy duplicate-module RuntimeWarning in test_cli.py subprocess test.

behavior: Metadata decoded as JSON/Python literal without coercing its contents, then validated against raw request strings before legacy coercion.
Pinned requested values001/true/None/nan and nested opaque version001/null survive CSV.
Conflicting duplicate metadata/pinned request rows refuse; identical pin duplicates and unrelated legacy duplicates retain behavior.
Malformed schema strings, bindings, filenames, versions, record shapes and syntax refuse without changing input bytes.
Utils explicit custom headers and unpinned legacy numeric/bool coercion preserved.
Actual pipeline writer-to-reader native roundtrip verifies output identity.
Utils metadata-only raw reread guarded by local file identity/size/mtime stamp; concurrent replacement never mixes old settings and new pins.
limitations: Metadata JSON markers use existing schema validator; no implicit inference, enrichment, provider, model, network or GPU I/O.
CSV-helper validation also runs in existing outer CLI file validation; this retains JSON reader behavior.
